profile.title: Lucy Loh
profile.canonical_definition: A systems and strategy practitioner who co-developed Patterns of Strategy with Patrick Hoverstadt and co-authored the book presenting the approach.
profile.summary: Lucy Loh co-developed Patterns of Strategy and co-authored its main publication, bringing systemic and management-science practice to strategic fit and manoeuvre.
profile.why_it_matters: Crediting a method to only one visible practitioner would reproduce the very false lineage problem the atlas is meant to resist.
common_misreadings: Patterns of Strategy is solely Patrick Hoverstadt's work
open_checks: develop Lucy Loh's broader practitioner profile and case history
